business_problem: gimmefy was operating a multi-model marketing platform across 14 AI providers, which created integration overhead, fallback costs, and 11-minute workflow latency that made content generation harder to scale profitably.
solution_summary: gimmefy consolidated its white-label marketing AI platform on Google Cloud so text, image, video, audio, and attachment workflows could run through one API surface instead of multiple vendor-specific integrations. Gemini 3.5 Flash simplified routing and fallback logic for the core platform, while Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 3 Pro Image, and Veo 3.1 handle multimodal campaign generation and model-arena evaluation use cases. The company also rebuilt its attachment pipeline around Gemini 3.5 Flash to process PDFs, slide decks, and audio media, and it uses downstream reporting and export integrations such as Search Console, GA4, YouTube, and Slides. This architecture reduced latency and cost while giving gimmefy one scalable Google Cloud backbone for brand-safe, partner-facing AI content generation.

data_flow: Customer briefs enter gimmefy's unified Google Cloud workflow, where Gemini models evaluate or generate text, image, and media outputs, Gemini 3.5 Flash processes attachments such as PDFs and audio, Veo 3.1 creates finished video assets, and the results feed reporting and export paths tied to Search Console, GA4, YouTube, and Slides.
business_outcome: After consolidating on Google Cloud, gimmefy reached a 98.5% task success rate, shifted Google models to 52.3% of traffic, generated 90.9% of platform images on Google AI, and made commercial video generation affordable enough to produce 1,236 brand clips.
